description: Check the words a brand wants to use for a supplement in Australia (an ad, a product page, a social post, an influencer caption, the words on the pack) against the TGA's advertising rules as takefridayoff.com/guides/tga-advertising sets them out. Flags "TGA approved", safe or free of side effects, guaranteed or miraculous, serious diseases (restricted and prohibited representations), testimonials and the endorsements the Code excludes, research claims, exaggeration, comparisons, free samples, and the statement an ad must carry. Each flag gives the words found, why, the guide's own words and the link. Foods and cosmetics are read against their own rules. It reads words, not meaning: no flags is not clearance, and it is not legal advice.

channel.description: Where it runs: ad_or_website (the default), online_store (a page that sells it), social_post (the brand's own post), influencer_post (someone else posting for the brand), label_or_pack (the words on the label or pack)

copy.description: The words to check: the ad, the product page text, the caption, or the claims on the pack

paid.description: Whoever is posting is paid or given anything of value for it (cash, free product, discounts, gifts)

pathway.description: What the product is: listed_medicine (AUST L), assessed_listed_medicine (AUST L(A)), food, cosmetic, or unknown (treated as a medicine; tfo_pathway_check can settle it)

name: tfo_claims_check
title: Check ad and claims copy
